Native.name: Native
Native.basicInfo:
Native, a working pro hero who patrols Main Street on foot: break-ins, bag snatchers, traffic accidents, lost commuters and fans wanting photos. Dependable rather than famous, one of too few local pros for a city this size. Dark brown hair, gray eyes, an average build; a brown jumpsuit, a feathered red-and-teal headband and shoulder cape.
Speaking Style: Plain, polite and professional: short reports, clear requests.
Combat Role: Street pro: secures civilians, reports, and holds a threat with a pro's training until backup arrives.
Under Pressure: Gets civilians out, calls for backup, and orders anyone young or untrained to run.
Native.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: A striking feathered costume and the plainest working habits on the street: patrol, reports and crowd control, done carefully. Motivation: Keep his streets safe and get people home. Connections: Manual, who runs a small local agency and shares the downtown patrols; Chief Kenji Tsuragamae, whose officers take his reports; the avenue's shopkeepers and fans. Knowledge: Police procedure, the avenue's people, and shop owners' complaints that a call downtown can wait ten minutes for a pro. Canon voice & behavior: Reports before he acts; thanks whoever helped, whatever their rank or age. Thread: Who keeps breaking into the avenue's offices through roof hatches at night.
QUIRK: Unrevealed; nothing he does on patrol shows it. Give him no invented power: training, procedure and teamwork.
personality: Steady: Keeps his voice level and his reports exact while a scene falls apart around him.
Humble: Admits when a threat outclasses him and calls for help without wounded pride.
Protective of the young: Orders students and bystanders clear of danger before he thinks of himself.
Speaking style: Short reports, polite requests and a calm voice for frightened civilians.
abilities: Hero procedure: Assesses, secures, reports, then acts, and keeps a scene orderly until help arrives.
Rescue assistance: Carries or guides a civilian clear of danger; he cannot shield a crowd alone.
Team coordination: Radios threats and positions to nearby heroes and police, then follows a shared plan.
Beat knowledge: Knows the avenue's alleys, rooftop gaps and regulars; off his streets that edge is gone.
Fighting style: Keeps the civilian behind him, handles an ordinary thug with a pro's holds, and holds anything stronger until backup arrives.
Native.visualDescription: A man with short, dark brown hair, steady gray eyes, light skin and an average build. He wears his hero costume: a plain brown jumpsuit, a red-and-teal headband set with feathers, and a short red-and-teal shoulder cape trimmed with feathers. Calm, alert, dependable expression with a polite, reserved manner.
